jobs.title: Medior Software Developer C#/.NET.
jobs.description:
Elektrotechnische installaties vind je werkelijk overal. Ook in de maritieme en offshore windenergie sector. In die gave wereld is MSA-Service actief. Het bedrijf verzorgt met een groeiend team maatwerk elektrotechnische automatiseringsoplossingen voor klanten. Hier in Nederland maar ook wereldwijd. Aan de slag gaan bij MSA-Service betekent de support krijgen van een ervaren team. Een team dat met je meedenkt en dat je af en toe uitdaagt een stap verder te gaan.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een **Medior Software Engineer**. In deze rol bestaan je werkzaamheden voornamelijk uit het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van onze software voor technische meet- en monitoringsystemen. Binnen deze oplossingen werken we onder andere met sensordata, data-analyse en nieuwe functionaliteiten voor onze maritieme en industriële toepassingen. De basis van je werkzaamheden ligt in C# en .NET.

Daarnaast gaat machinelearning binnen onze software een steeds grotere rol spelen. Je hoeft hiervoor geen AI-specialist te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die hier interesse in heeft, al enige basiservaring heeft en zich hierin verder wil ontwikkelen.

**Jouw werkzaamheden:**

· Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van software in C# en .NET

· Analyseren en oplossen van technische problemen in bestaande software

· Ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen onze meet en monitorsystemen.

· Werken met SQL, databases, API's en Git

· Schrijven van onderhoudbare en testbare code

· Testen en verbeteren van bestaande functionaliteiten

· Werken met meetgegevens en sensordata

· Meedenken over toepassingen voor data-analyse en machine learning

· Afstemmen met developers, technische specialisten en gebruikers

**Dit ben jij:**

· HBO werk- en denkniveau, via opleiding of praktijkervaring

· Bij voorkeur minimaal 4 jaar relevante werkervaring; jouw niveau is voor ons belangrijker dan het exacte aantal jaren

· Goede kennis van C# en .NET

· Ervaring met SQL, databases, API's en Git

· Analytisch en praktisch ingesteld en in staat om zelfstandig te werken

· Zorgvuldige werkwijze en duidelijke communicatie over voortgang en technische problemen

· Goede beheersing van het Engels voor technische documentatie en samenwerking

**Dit bieden we jou:**

· Een uitdagende functie binnen een innovatief en technisch bedrijf

· Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week

· Veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, onder andere richting data-analyse en machine learning

· Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de cao metaal en techniek, aangevuld met onze eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden

· Salaris op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring

· 25 vakantiedagen + 13 Adv-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband

· Leuke teamuitjes en een divers en hecht team

· Uitzicht op een vast contract

**Interesse?**

Klaar om jouw softwarekennis in te zetten voor technische toepassingen die je terugziet in de praktijk? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Meer weten? Neem contact met ons op via of 0184-611 555

Salaris: €3.300,00 - €4.250,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Fietsplan
* Kosteloos parkeren
* Pensioen

Werklocatie: Fysiek

jobs.title: IT Application Developer
jobs.description:
**Help shape the future of smart manufacturing.**

We're looking for a **Software Developer** to design, develop and support manufacturing applications that enable reliable, secure and efficient production operations. In this role, you'll work with modern technologies, collaborate with business and IT teams, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our manufacturing systems.

### **What you'll do**

* Design, develop and implement software solutions that meet business and technical requirements.
* Ensure applications are scalable, secure, high-performing and reliable.
* Support the full application lifecycle, from implementation and enhancement to maintenance and retirement.
* Participate in application upgrades, including testing, deployment, version management and validation.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, including participation in an on-call support rotation.
* Configure and customize applications to meet manufacturing business needs, working closely with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Apply development best practices, coding standards and modern ways of working.
* Identify and implement improvements to enhance application performance, availability and reliability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to integrate applications and ensure seamless data flow across systems.
* Maintain high-quality technical documentation, including user guides, configuration documentation and knowledge base articles.
* Ensure compliance with IT security policies and industry standards while protecting sensitive business data.
* Contribute to process improvements and continuous development of manufacturing applications.
* Always follow company safety rules and regulations.

### **What you'll bring**

* B.Sc. in Information Systems, Information Technology or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience developing software using technologies such as **C/C++**, **C#**, **PL/SQL** or **JavaScript**.
* Knowledge of **DevOps tools** (e.g. Git) and modern software development practices.
* Experience with **server operating systems**, **Oracle**, **MySQL** or other database technologies.
* Understanding of **cloud technologies**.
* Experience with **MES/MOM**, **OCP** or similar manufacturing execution systems is highly valued.
* Knowledge of IT security best practices and compliance standards.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills in English.

jobs.description:
### **General Information**

**Locations**: Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden

Role ID

216110

Worker Type

Intern - Temporary Employee

Studio/Department

CT - Frostbite

Work Model

Hybrid

### **Description & Requirements**

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

**Contract:** 6-month internship

**Start Date:** Late January 2027

**Work Model:** Hybrid (3 days minimum onsite)

  
  

**The Challenge Ahead**

  
  

Frostbite is EA’s proprietary game engine, powering many of our leading titles across EA SPORTS, Battlefield, and more. We develop shared tools and technologies that connect and empower creators throughout EA. On Frostbite, you’ll collaborate with accomplished teams and contribute to the foundation that enables the creation of immersive, high-quality games for players worldwide.

  
  

As a Master's Thesis Intern, you will develop a project in an area where Frostbite's engineering efficiency can be multiplied with generative AI, agents, or context engineering. You will also gain an understanding of what it's like to work at EA. An open application means that you can provide ideas for what you want to work on, but we can also explore this together, based on your experiences and interests.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* You will investigate and prototype applying GenAI solutions to Frostbite's development process.
  
* You will review designs and implementations with other software engineers and will validate your results using a representative dataset.
  
* You will report to an engineering manager, attend meetings, present progress information and write a final report.
  

  

**Eligibility:**

* You are pursuing a MsC. in Computer Science (or a related field).
  
* You are associated with a university education or any other type of education in Sweden that has an internship period planned into the education plan.
  

  

**Skills:**

* You have experience with Python, C# or C++.
  
* You understand software development processes.
  
* You have an interest in applying GenAI to software engineering (e.g. GitHub, CoPilot).
  
* You have knowledge of AI concepts like knowledge graphs, vector databases, context engineering, MCP servers, LangChain, or RAG.
  
* You understand software quality, test automation, or CI/CD.
  

  

Help us make play happen. Apply now with an up-to-date CV and Cover Letter in **English**, explaining what project you would like to work on and explain your pick based on your interests and skills.

  

***About Electronic Arts***

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

  

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

  

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Last date to apply:**

23 October 2026

**About the Team**

You will join a team within the R&D organization that develops innovative software solutions for our handheld battery products. You will be supporting both Advanced Development initiatives and core Drive Systems activities, playing a key role in shaping future products while continuously improving existing solutions.

**About the Role**

As a **Software Engineer**, you will contribute to pre-develop solutions and initiative, new product development and the maintenance and enhancement of existing products. You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where software, electronics, and mechanics come together to create high-performing handheld battery tools.

In this role, you will be closely involved in both software and product development, collaborating with skilled colleagues across different engineering disciplines. Experience in electrical motor control is considered a strong advantage.

**Your Profile**

We are looking for a creative and self-motivated **Software Engineer** who enjoys solving complex technical challenges. You thrive in an environment where not every requirement is predefined and are comfortable taking ownership, driving initiatives forward, and turning ideas into practical solutions.

You have experience in embedded software development and can translate technical needs into robust, efficient, and maintainable software solutions.

*Qualifications:*

University degree within software engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

A few years of experience in low level embedded software development. Experience within motor control and battery systems is a strong plus. Also knowledge in safety standards and cyber security (CRA etc.).

  

* Good knowledge of C, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Git, and serial communication.
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written.
* Experience from Jira, C++/C#

**Location**

Our team is based in Huskvarna.

**How we work**

We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

**Application**

Does this sound interesting? Don't hesitate to apply as soon as possible, as we apply ongoing selection. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR regulations.

For more information about the position please contact Hiring Manager Joakim Wibring, Manager Software at Joakim.Wibring@husqvarnagroup.com.

For questions regarding the recruitment process please contact Talent Acquisition partner – Katarina Engberg at katarina.engberg@husqvarnagroup.com.

**Processing of personal data**

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

**Winning Through Culture**

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters. Our culture is built on three core themes:

* **Bold**: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
* **Dedicated**: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
* **Care**: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture *here*.

jobs.description:

The world needs a sustainable energy future. Achieving net‑zero emissions is a tremendous challenge, and subsea technology has a critical and exciting role to play. That’s why we at OneSubsea need pioneers and visionaries. Problem‑solvers and collaborators. Curious minds and innovators. Experts and apprentices who care, work together, and drive us forward. OneSubsea is a world‑leading provider of subsea technology, enabling efficient utilization of energy resources and accelerating the transition to a more sustainable future.

We are now looking for a **Control System Software Engineer** to join our team in **Bergen, Sandsli**.

#### **About the role**

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most advanced subsea production systems in the world. As a Control Systems Engineer with SLB OneSubsea, you're not just designing control logic, you're helping to enable the safe and efficient operation of subsea energy infrastructure that operates thousands of meters below the ocean surface.

You'll work with cutting-edge subsea control systems, automation, communications, and power distribution technologies. The role combines software, hardware, systems engineering, and real-world operational challenges, making it highly technical and intellectually stimulating.

SLB OneSubsea offers a unique environment where engineers are involved throughout the entire lifecycle, from concept development and design to testing, commissioning, and field support. This means you can see the direct impact of your work on major global projects.

The company also has a strong international footprint, giving you exposure to global teams, customers, and projects. If you're looking for a role where you can develop both deep technical expertise and broader project and customer-facing skills, this is a great platform.

#### **Key responsibilities include**

* Designing, implementing, and testing control system software for subsea systems

* Performing modifications and upgrades to delivered control systems through aftermarket activities

* Participating in component, functional, system, and interface testing

* Working closely with suppliers during testing activities at supplier locations

* Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams across all project phases

* Supporting implementation and handover of control system software for subsea products and systems

#### **We are looking for someone who**

Is excited by the opportunity to work with industry-leading subsea technology and contribute to solutions that support a more sustainable energy future. This role offers the chance to tackle complex engineering challenges while collaborating with highly skilled colleagues across multidisciplinary teams in an environment that values knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous development.

The ideal candidate holds as a minimum a BSc in automation, cybernetics, computer science, IT, or a related engineering discipline. Experience with PLC-based control systems is considered a strong advantage, however we also value relevant practical experience and transferable skills and encourage candidates with diverse backgrounds to apply.

#### **Required experience**

* Has minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience

* Is fluent in English, both spoken and written

* Has a positive, practical, and solution-oriented mindset with high drive and strong capacity to deliver

* Can work both independently and as part of multidisciplinary teams

#### **It is a bonus if you have**

* Experience with Rockwell Automation products (e.g. Allen-Bradley PLCs or FactoryTalk View HMI software)

* Experience with Hyper-V virtualization or VMware solutions

* Experience with Microsoft Windows Server

* Understanding of quality assurance and software testing methods

* Knowledge of HTML5 and modern visualization/presentation tools

* Use of AI tools to support development and improve workflows

#### **With us, you will experience**

* Collaboration with highly qualified engineers working with leading energy companies worldwide

* A dynamic workday where you influence technical solutions and outcomes

* An international work environment that values initiative and innovation

* Varied tasks across projects, customers, and technologies

* Flexible working arrangements, including home‑office opportunities

* Modern facilities at Sandsli, including parking, in‑house gym, and high‑quality cafeteria

* Strong development opportunities within OneSubsea and SLB

#### **Interested?**

To be considered for this position, please attach:

* CV in English

* Transcripts of Records or other documentation detailing education and grades

Applications missing this documentation will not be considered.

#### **Diversity and Inclusion**

At OneSubsea, we see our diverse workforce as a great advantage. We promote an inclusive work environment where equal opportunities, diversity, and inclusion are key to our success. We believe that diversity enriches us, attracts talent, and makes working life more exciting. Therefore, we encourage all candidates to apply - regardless of background, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, gender, ethnicity, disability, or age.

**Om bedriften**
----------------

OneSubsea is a world-leading provider of subsea technology, enabling efficient utilization of energy resources and accelerating the transition to a more sustainable future.

SLB, OneSubsea processing, Aker Solutions, and Subsea7 have come together to create the world’s leading subsea technology and solutions provider.

We are focused on accelerating innovation to create a step change in subsea production economics and reduce emissions in subsea operations.

The joint venture brings together deep reservoir domain expertise, broad front-end and system design knowledge.

We provide an extensive field-proven subsea production and processing technology portfolio, world-class manufacturing scale and capacity, and unique pore-to-process integration capabilities.
